objective: Finite pathwise decomposition of a full multi-bar two-asset native-funded replay versus counterfactual first-observed-substep exits, with the same native entry quantities, receipt-clock and historical admission checks.
structural_hypothesis: The terminal wealth difference is exactly the sum of differences in inventory exposure to observed marks, fill-at-mark residuals, and identical fixed costs; independent exit clocks can change known spendable cash at subsequent admissions, preventing free assertion of an endogenous same-quantity coupling.
counter_hypothesis: If any native-funded complete campaign cannot be reconciled to independent two-ledger cash/position accounting, or same-quantity counterfactual positions cannot be self-financed, native-to-first-cross equivalence is not shown; do not open signals.
refutation_criteria: Any mismatch of modeled and funded native executed quantities, timestamps, reason, price or costs
Any negative cash, negative share balance, unsupported substep tape, or unreconciled terminal net
Any difference between independent Decimal and JS accounting beyond 0.00005 USD
Any event is processed at knownAt for mark PnL before actual at, or sale proceeds used as spendable prior to knownAt
Any claim the original 12% reservation limit is continuous or that fixed native entries are endogenously reoptimised under causal execution
fixtures: baseline two-asset full native 72-hour time exits
target then stop intrabar counterexample followed by second asset
controls: identical same native entries and quantities
CASH accounting with original per-calendar-day fixed fee
previous best retained as registered M10 QUALITY_NATIVE_QUEUE72_R0625, no rerun, no new seed
scope_exclusions: no new alpha or final oracles
